question: Who led Clarity Systems' August 2026 seed round?

hits.title: Clarity Systems Closes Seed Round Led by LMnT Ventures to Tackle Returns Fraud | FinancialContent
hits.snippet: Clarity Systems, a retail fraud detection company, today announced the close of a $4.4 million seed round backed by LMnT Ventures, with participation from Regeneration VC, Humba Ventures, and Massive Technology Ventures. The Company’s system sees inside returned and received products in three seconds without having to manually open them - catching counterfeits, product swaps, and manipulation by comparing items or potential fraudulent items against the original manufacturer profile. ... Q: How much did Clarity Systems raise, and who led the round? ... - Clarity closed a $4.4 million seed round, backed by LMnT Ventures. Other investors include Regeneration VC, Humba Ventures, and Massive Technology Ventures.

hits.title: Clarity Systems raises $4.4M seed to catch returns fraud without opening the box | Dealroom.co
hits.snippet: What's the deal? Clarity Systems, a San Francisco retail fraud detection startup, has closed a $4.4 million seed round led by LMnT Ventures. Regeneration VC, Humba Ventures, and Massive Technology Ventures also participated. ... Zoom in: Backers point to working deployments rather than promises. "This isn't AI theory — it's already happening on Clarity systems," said Jeff Miller, founder and managing partner of LMnT Ventures.

hits.title: Clarity Systems Raises $4.4M in Seed Funding
hits.snippet: Clarity Systems, a San Francisco, CA-based retail fraud detection company, raised $4.4M in Seed funding. ... Backers included LMnT Ventures, Regeneration VC, Humba Ventures, and Massive Technology Ventures. ... Led by CEO Andy Ruben, Clarity Systems provides a retail fraud detection platform that combines diagnostic-grade X-ray intelligence with computer vision and AI to see inside returned and received products in three seconds or less without opening the box. Their platform analyzes products and instantly detects anomalies such as counterfeit goods, product swaps, missing components, or other forms of return fraud by comparing items against their original manufacturer profile.

hits.title: Clarity Systems Secures $4.4 Million
hits.snippet: Clarity Systems, an AI powered company that can detect retail fraud by seeing inside returned products without having to open them, said it has just closed a $4.4 million seed round. ... In a statement, it said the funding was backed by LMnT Ventures, with participation from Regeneration VC, Humba Ventures, and Massive Technology Ventures. ... “Return fraud is a stubborn, massive problem hiding in plain sight, costing the world’s largest brands billions and ultimately leaving everyday consumers to foot the bill. And it’s a problem that the founders, each with extensive experience in the retail and returns world have had to endure for decades,” Jeff Miller, founder and managing partner of LMnT Ventures, said.

accuracy.note: Answer matches gold lead investor LMnT Ventures
